faces: left (as the wraith_lord sweep clip; mirror with the sprite)

notes: The scythe reaping a full low loop round the wraith at knee height: the near half (in front of its legs) whips from 2.4 m behind to 3.4 m in front, then the far half carries on behind its legs back round; soul-ice cyan from its own scythe glow; grit and a dust breath kicked along the ground, motes shed.
